# AI Video Generation

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a smart meta-router across RunComfy's full AI video-model catalog: HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1, native in-pass audio), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (open weights, audio-driven lip-sync), ByteDance Seedance v2/1-5/1-0, Kling 3.0/2-6, Google Veo 3-1, MiniMax Hailuo 2-3, Dreamina 3-0. It picks the right model for the user's intent (quality, character identity, in-pass audio, cinematic motion, fastest path, longest duration) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the exact `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate video", "text to video", "animate", "video from image", and similar. Distinct from the model-specific guides in the same repo (seedance-v2, kling-3-0): this one is the router that decides which model to use; those are the deep dives once the choice is made. Requires a RunComfy account, the RunComfy CLI (`npm i -g @runcomfy/cli`), and generation calls are billed against API credits — a paid service. Honest notes: the source docs use RunComfy's "Pro Pack" marketing voice and carry tracking links; the technical content (endpoints, schemas, examples) is real and documented. By @prime-skills, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
